vetSays.line: 🛡️ Tanya, Christian, Vsevolod and Tobias met them at the door — 4 put down. Tanya, Christian, Vsevolod, Tobias are hurt.
🛡️ Tanya, Christian, Benoit and Meera met them at the door — 4 put down. Tanya, Christian, Benoit, Meera are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Benoit — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Benoit chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vsevolod just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Christian just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Tanya strikes the Scarred Big Loud.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Big Loud falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Loud!
📺 You brought down Scarred Big Loud. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Scarred Big Loud.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tanya just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ruby and Sifan met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ruby, Sifan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Sifan taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Christian has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Sifan is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
🛡️ Ruby, Sifan and Yamila met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sifan, Yamila are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sifan just put down The Editor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sifan met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
Sifan: "European Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
